skill.name: API Design Principles
skill.domain: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers and stand the test of time.

tasks.prompt: Design a GraphQL query that fetches a user’s posts with pagination, filtering by date range, and sorting by creation time. Use arguments, not fragments.
tasks.criterion: Query uses arguments for pagination, date filtering, and sorting, returns ordered and paginated posts, and avoids unnecessary fragments or nested queries.

tasks.prompt: Design a GraphQL mutation to create a comment on a post, returning the created comment with nested author and post details. Use input types and avoid exposing internal IDs.
tasks.criterion: Mutation uses input type, returns created comment with nested author and post fields, does not expose internal IDs, and returns 200 with valid data or 400 on error.

tasks.prompt: Implement rate limiting on a REST API endpoint using headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset) and return 429 when exceeded.
tasks.criterion: Endpoint responds with correct rate limit headers and 429 status when limit exceeded, resets correctly on interval, and allows requests within limit.

tasks.prompt: Design a REST API endpoint to upload a profile image with metadata. Use multipart/form-data, validate file type and size, and return a secure URL upon success.
tasks.criterion: Endpoint accepts multipart/form-data, validates file type/size, returns 201 with secure URL on success, and 400 on invalid input or 500 on upload failure.

tasks.prompt: Apply consistent naming conventions across REST endpoints: plural nouns, lowercase, hyphenated, no verbs. Ensure all endpoints follow this pattern.
tasks.criterion: All endpoints use plural nouns (e.g., /users, /posts), lowercase, hyphenated, no verbs, and follow uniform structure without exceptions.

tasks.prompt: Apply HATEOAS to a REST user endpoint by including links to related resources: self, posts, and delete. Use standard Link headers or embedded JSON links.
tasks.criterion: Response includes properly formatted HATEOAS links (self, posts, delete) in JSON or Link header, uses valid URIs, and no hard-coded URLs.

tasks.prompt: Implement GraphQL field arguments with default values and validation for a search endpoint. Reject invalid values with clear error messages.
tasks.criterion: Field uses default values, rejects invalid inputs with descriptive errors, and returns valid results when arguments are within bounds.

tasks.prompt: Implement REST API versioning using URL paths (e.g., /v1/users) and ensure backward compatibility for v1 while introducing v2 with new fields.
tasks.criterion: v1 and v2 endpoints coexist, v1 remains unchanged, v2 adds fields without breaking v1, and both return correct content-type and status codes.

tasks.prompt: Use GraphQL interfaces to define a unified response type for both User and Organization that share common fields like id, name, and avatar.
tasks.criterion: Interface defines shared fields, User and Organization implement it correctly, queries can request interface type without errors or ambiguity.

tasks.prompt: Design a REST API endpoint to bulk delete users by ID array. Use POST with JSON body, return summary of successes and failures.
tasks.criterion: Endpoint accepts POST with JSON array of IDs, returns 200 with summary of deleted/failed IDs, and does not delete without explicit body.
